fields.statement: At f41bce522 (attempt 2): go test -trimpath ./internal/web -run TestTypeScale exit 0 and go test -trimpath ./internal/web/... exit 0, as in the Checks: block. Attempt 1's finding is fixed: .rz-step::before is back to left: 10.5px, and across both leaf commits (980db15cb, f41bce522) rhiza.css and templates/change.html change only font, font-size and line-height values, all now var(--fs-*)/var(--lh-*); rhiza-tokens.css adds exactly the 13 size and 11 line-height tokens.
